name: RECOGNITION_GAP_SELECTION_FAILFAST_ADMISSION

g0.distinct_estimand: Conditional on a real PIT-observable operating transition already being present, does contemporaneous recognition lag add selection information: Reality + RecognitionGap versus Reality alone?
g0.success_metric_contract: Later D6 selection enrichment for Reality + RecognitionGap versus Reality alone under a separately preregistered wager law; no metric is evaluated in this slice.
g0.primary_horizon_contract: UNSET_THIS_SLICE; inheriting CRV1's 252-trading-day primary horizon is forbidden and any later economic horizon must be frozen separately before result access.
g0.crv1_boundary: CYCLE_RESONANCE_v1 is a broad ordered-cycle family whose supply/capacity -> inventory -> pricing -> margin -> earnings-revisions -> expectation-gap chain targets a 252-trading-day right-tail winner. TR-v0 conditions on Reality already being present and studies recognition lag only as the missing selector.
g0.decision: Distinct causal family admission is warranted. If later work needs CRV1's broad ordered-cycle contract, 252d label, or resonance score to define TR-v0, route/merge to CRV1 rather than duplicate it.

g1.recognition_state: The latest lawful point-in-time consensus/expectation state known at decision as_of for the permanent security identity, using source-bound expectation rows only.
g1.recognition_gap: Given Reality=true, the operating transition has moved farther than contemporaneous consensus recognition. Exact normalization/materiality operators remain L2 work and may not be derived from future returns, future prices, or failed FTK payoffs.
as_of_lag_law: latest lawful vintage only; no backdating or future vintage
observed consensus and inferred market-implied state must remain explicitly labeled
missing/stale/not-entitled required recognition state maps to ABSTAIN
g1.missingness: ABSTAIN; never infer recognition from missing data and never use missingness to create a favorable selector denominator.
g1.source_feasibility: PASS_IN_PRINCIPLE: alpha_pit_data_api_v1 already defines a PIT expectation surface with permanent identity, available_at, source receipt, epistemic class, and explicit missingness. L2 must bind a TR-v0-specific family/source contract before any empirical use; CRV1 family artifacts are not TR-v0 authority.

g2.reality_node: PIT-observable operating-transition observation established independently of recognition. It may reuse lawful transition primitives, but it is not the failed FTK economic policy, K=20 rank/action map, H=63 hold law, or residual outcome state.
g2.recognition_node: Consensus/expectation state from a separate expectations surface.
g2.incrementality: RecognitionGap has independent economic meaning as 'transition occurring but not yet incorporated in contemporaneous expectations'. It is not another inventory/margin transition score.
forbidden_reencodings: inventory transition score relabeled as recognition
margin transition score relabeled as recognition
H/K/threshold chosen from FTK residual outcomes
price or return reaction used to define recognition

l0_question: Conditional on a real PIT-observable operating transition, does an independently observable recognition/consensus gap identify which transitions are economically selectable (not-yet-recognized) versus already-recognized?
h1: Among firms exhibiting a real operating transition, future economic selection enrichment under a later preregistered wager law is higher when contemporaneous consensus recognition materially lags the observed transition, versus transitions already recognized.

falsifiers.F1: Recognition cannot be defined independently of future returns -> KILL.
falsifiers.F2: Recognition is merely another encoding of the same transition -> KILL / not incremental.
falsifiers.F3: Hypothesis is materially identical to CRV1 -> MERGE/ROUTE.
falsifiers.F4: Useful recognition state appears only after inspecting failed FTK dates/payoffs -> KILL.
falsifiers.F5: Mechanism requires choosing H/K/threshold from prior economic residuals -> KILL.
